annotations.title: Make an image set in other product colours

description: Makes a finished image set’s main image in other colours of the product, for colour variations and swatches (stores show one image per colour; all_images true makes every image, shot for shot): only the product’s colour changes, the scene and text stay. Each colour becomes its own image set. Images with the product cost 1 credit each per colour (an edit); images without it are copied free. A hex code or a photo of the product in that colour (photo_base64) makes the colour more exact. Call with dry_run true first and tell the person the cost; then call without it (spends credits). Returns the new image set ids; follow them with get_image_set. Example: {"image_set_id": "…", "colours": [{"name": "Navy", "hex": "#1F3A5F"}], "dry_run": true}

all_images.description: Every image of the set in each colour, not only the main image (default false)

name.description: The colour as the seller names it, e.g. "Sage green" (or send only hex)

note.description: How the colour is applied, e.g. "only the body; the zip stays silver"

photo_base64.description: A photo of the product in this colour (JPEG/PNG/WebP)

dry_run.description: Only return the cost; nothing is made or spent

name: recolour_image_set
